title: Sonar
description: Documented public information: sonar (sound navigation and ranging) uses sound pulses in water to detect objects — active (emitting pulses) and passive (listening). Documented history: developed through WWI–WWII; now essential for submarines, ships, and oceanography. A foundational documented sound use.
how_it_works: Sound pulses travel through water; echoes reveal distance and direction; passive systems listen for emitted sounds.
applications: Naval navigation, depth sounding, fish finding, ocean mapping — documented.

title: Medical Ultrasound Imaging
description: Documented public information: medical ultrasound uses high-frequency sound waves to image the body — famously prenatal imaging, plus cardiac, abdominal, and emergency uses. Documented history: clinical use from the 1950s–70s. A documented medical sound use.
how_it_works: Transducers emit pulses; echoes from tissue boundaries build images; Doppler modes show blood flow.
applications: Obstetrics, cardiology, emergency medicine — documented medicine.
disclaimer: General information only; medical decisions belong to qualified professionals.

title: Echolocation in Nature (Documented)
description: Documented public information: bats, dolphins, and other animals use biological echolocation — documented science. Human echolocation by blind individuals is also documented in research. A documented natural sound use.
how_it_works: Animals emit calls and interpret echoes; documented neural specializations support it.
applications: Biology, biomimetic engineering inspiration — documented science.

title: Non-Destructive Testing
description: Documented public information: ultrasonic non-destructive testing inspects materials and welds for flaws without damaging them — documented industrial standard. A documented industrial sound use.
how_it_works: Ultrasonic pulses probe materials; reflections reveal cracks, voids, and thickness.

title: Speech and Telephony
description: Documented public information: the human voice — speech — is the original documented sound use; telephony (documented from Bell, 1876) carries it electrically; VoIP carries it as data. A foundational documented sound use.
how_it_works: Vocal cords produce sound; microphones transduce it; networks carry it; speakers reproduce it.
applications: Conversation, telephony, broadcasting, voice assistants — documented.

title: Music Technology
description: Documented public information: music technology — instruments, recording (documented from Edison’s phonograph, 1877), synthesis, streaming — is a vast documented sound use. MIDI (documented 1980s), digital audio workstations, and compressed formats (MP3, documented 1990s) are documented standards.
how_it_works: Sound captured, synthesized, or processed; stored and reproduced via documented formats and standards.
applications: Music production, distribution, performance — documented worldwide.

title: Hearing Aids and Cochlear Implants
description: Documented public information: hearing aids amplify sound (documented); cochlear implants bypass damaged hearing with electrical stimulation (documented, from 1970s–80s research to modern devices). Documented medical sound uses.
how_it_works: Hearing aids amplify and shape sound; implants convert sound to electrical signals for the auditory nerve.
disclaimer: General information only; consult qualified professionals.

title: Acoustic Levitation (Documented Research)
description: Documented public information: researchers have documented suspending small objects with standing sound waves — acoustic levitation, used in containerless processing research. Documented as research — a real, honestly-bounded phenomenon.
how_it_works: Standing waves create pressure nodes; small objects rest in the nodes.
applications: Materials research, micro-assembly concepts — documented research.

title: Seismic Surveying
description: Documented public information: seismic surveys use sound waves (in earth) to map subsurface structures — documented in oil/gas exploration and earthquake science. A documented scientific sound use.
how_it_works: Controlled sources generate waves; reflections map underground layers.

title: Emergency Sirens and Alarms
description: Documented public information: sirens, alarms, and warning sounds — from civil-defense sirens (documented) to smoke alarms and vehicle sirens — are documented safety uses of sound. Standards govern their audibility.
how_it_works: Loud, distinctive sounds alert populations; standards ensure recognition.
applications: Disaster warning, fire safety, emergency vehicles — documented.

title: Noise-Canceling Technology
description: Documented public information: active noise cancellation — anti-phase sound canceling ambient noise — is documented in headphones and other applications. A documented applied sound use.
how_it_works: Microphones sample noise; processors generate canceling anti-phase sound.
applications: Headphones, aviation headsets, building systems — documented.

title: Ultrasonic Cleaning
description: Documented public information: ultrasonic cleaners use high-frequency sound in liquid to clean delicate items — documented industrial and consumer use (jewelry, instruments, medical tools).
how_it_works: Ultrasound creates cavitation bubbles in liquid; their collapse scrubs surfaces.
applications: Manufacturing, medical instrument cleaning, jewelry — documented.

title: Architectural Acoustics
description: Documented public information: architectural acoustics — designing spaces for sound (concert halls, documented; noise control in buildings) — is a documented science and engineering discipline.
how_it_works: Geometry, materials, and absorption shape reverberation and clarity.
applications: Concert halls, studios, offices, homes — documented.

title: Voice Assistants and Recognition
description: Documented public information: automatic speech recognition powers voice assistants and dictation — documented from early research to modern neural systems. A documented computational sound use.
how_it_works: Microphones capture speech; models transcribe and interpret.

title: Therapeutic Ultrasound (Documented)
description: Documented public information: therapeutic ultrasound has documented medical uses — physiotherapy applications and focused-ultrasound procedures (documented, e.g., uterine fibroid treatment) — practiced by qualified professionals. Documented as medicine, not as consumer wellness.
how_it_works: Focused sound energy heats or disrupts targeted tissue under professional control.
disclaimer: General information only; medical decisions belong to qualified professionals.

title: Animal Communication Research
description: Documented public information: bioacoustics — studying animal sounds (whale song, documented; bird calls) — is documented science with conservation applications.
how_it_works: Hydrophones and recorders capture; analysis reveals patterns.

title: Public Address Systems
description: Documented public information: PA systems amplify voice/music for crowds — documented from early electric systems to modern line arrays. A documented communication sound use.
how_it_works: Microphones, amplifiers, and speaker arrays distribute sound to audiences.
applications: Events, transit announcements, emergency voice — documented.

title: Infrasound Monitoring (Documented)
description: Documented public information: infrasound arrays monitor for nuclear tests (documented: CTBTO network) and study volcanoes and meteors. A documented scientific sound use — listening below hearing.
how_it_works: Sensitive arrays detect low-frequency waves traveling vast distances.

title: The Scope Note
description: Scope note: this database documents PUBLIC, established sound uses. Medical entries are general information, not guidance. For his speculative sound concepts, see the companion Signature databases.
how_it_works: As a scope note: the documented shelf vs the speculative shelf.

title: Sound Uses: The Complete Map
description: Summary: sound finds submarines (sonar), sees inside bodies (ultrasound), carries voices (speech/telephony), makes music (technology), tests materials (NDT), warns populations (sirens), cancels noise (ANC), cleans (ultrasonic), and studies the earth and animals. The documented map — the factual basis for the section’s sound concepts.
how_it_works: As a summary: the full documented landscape.

title: Acoustic Ecology
description: Documented public information: acoustic ecology / soundscape studies — documenting environments through their sounds — is a documented field with conservation uses.
how_it_works: Long-term recorders capture soundscapes; analysis tracks biodiversity and change.

title: Lithotripsy (Documented)
description: Documented public information: shock-wave lithotripsy — using focused sound waves to break kidney stones — is documented medicine practiced by professionals.
how_it_works: Focused acoustic pulses fragment stones non-invasively.
disclaimer: General information only; consult qualified professionals.

title: Ways to Use Sound: Closing
description: Closing: every documented sound use — fact-checked, public, established. The database’s standing: the documented is the ground; his Signature concepts are the playground.
how_it_works: As a closing: the public shelf, complete.

description: A boundary record: where documented sound uses end and his speculative sound concepts begin — the line drawn per record throughout this section. "The documented is the ground; the playground is labeled."
